data.name: Real Life: Dorm Affairs
data.detailed_description:
Story

Mike arrives in a sunlit seaside city hoping to work his way through college, but his new job at a women’s dorm quickly becomes more than expected. As he grows close to the girls who depend on him, he’s drawn into a mix of romance, loyalty, and the city’s hidden criminal networks — where local gangs prey on vulnerable students, pushing Mike into dangerous choices that could change all their lives.

Gameplay

Real Life: Dorm Affairs is a third-person story-driven game where you bring a struggling dormitory back to life. Clean, repair, and restore abandoned rooms, welcome new female students, and decide who to help, who to trust, and who to grow closer to. Your actions shape Mike’s relationships with each of them and influence how life in the dorm will change. Throughout Early Access, the game will expand with new rooms, new students, and new storylines.

Key Features

  • Third-person story-driven gameplay focused on grounded drama, relationships, and character choices.

  • Open-world districts with visitable locations such as a beach restaurant, gift shop, and more.

  • Drivable cars, scooters, and motorboats, with the ability to pick up NPCs during certain activities.

  • Two in-game radio stations with curated music playing across vehicles, public spaces, and interiors, enhancing the overall atmosphere.

  • Occasional street fights and protecting female students from gangs.

  • Relationship and dialogue system that reflects trust, choices, and character interactions.

  • Ability to purchase street food and drinks across the city.

  • In-game smartphone with apps for inventory, character customization, city map, and quest journal.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 or equivalent (Shader Model 5.1 support required)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 28 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: For the best experience, use SSD storage.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or above
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 5700 XT or above
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 28 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: For the best experience, use SSD storage.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains mature themes such as interpersonal drama, romance, and references to college life. It also includes occasional suggestive dialogue, characters wearing modern revealing fashion (such as swimwear or short dresses), and storylines involving crime-related situations.

All characters in the game are over the age of 18.
